blurb: The Dot Experience in Louisville, Kentucky, is the first inclusive attraction in the world to make every exhibit, image, and artifact accessible to everyone-including people who may not be able to see them. This one-of-kind Louisville attraction invites visitors of all ages and abilities to experience interactive exhibits, sensory experiences, and groundbreaking accessibility innovations.
